title: House-sized tall white deep spacecraft seen in person

tellings.quote: see how this house is one that I personally saw was a little bit longer than this house a little bit wider than this house about half again as high as this house

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years in the 1960s living alongside tall, white-skinned aliens near Area 51, a secret US military test site in Nevada, says he saw one of their deep space craft up close in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada. He describes it as about the size of a house: a bit longer and wider than one, and about half again as tall. If true, it would mean alien craft were parked near a US base.
